text:
Paying EMI on a flat that never got built? On 19 Nov the Supreme Court paused loan recovery for two groups of stalled-project buyers.

Sonipat: no coercive recovery until a court checks if buyers really defaulted and if the bank paid the builder in stages, as the three-way deal said.
Bengaluru: about 4,500 buyers protected till they get their flats.

Not an EMI waiver. When a project stalls, who should carry the risk: buyer or bank?
